name: final-preflight
command: test ! -e node_modules && test ! -L node_modules && test ! -e src/web/node_modules && git show -s --format=fuller HEAD && node -e 'for (const mod of ["@base-ui/react/button", "@base-ui/react/dialog"]) { try { console.log(require.resolve(mod, {paths: [process.cwd()+"/src/web"]})); process.exitCode=1; } catch(e) { if(e.code!=="MODULE_NOT_FOUND") throw e; console.log(mod, e.code); } }'
